# SkillScout

> SkillScout is an AI-powered mock interview preparation platform for software engineers.
> It provides real-time code analysis, system design practice, voice-mode mock interviews,
> and personalized feedback benchmarked against hiring standards at top tech companies.

## Core Features

- Mock Interview: Full end-to-end simulated technical interviews with AI interviewer
- Real-time Code Analysis: Live feedback on code quality during practice
- System Design Canvas: Interactive whiteboard for system design interview practice
- Voice Mode: Spoken interview simulation for behavioral and verbal practice
- Instant Feedback: Post-session scoring and improvement recommendations
- Benchmarking: Performance tracking against target company hiring bars

- [Blog](https://www.skillscout.dev/resources): Interview preparation articles and guides
